parameters.query:
SELECT bp.title, bp.url, bp.content, sa.category, sa.tags
FROM blog_posts bp
LEFT JOIN security_aggregations sa ON sa.title ILIKE '%' || bp.title || '%'
WHERE bp.user_id = $1
ORDER BY bp.created_at DESC
LIMIT 50;
